basic_info.name: Sabin Diagnostico e Saude (Grupo Sabin) + Laboratorio Hermes Pardini. IMPORTANT PREMISE CORRECTION: they are NOT one group and never were. The task brief said 'one group since 2023' — that merger was Fleury + Hermes Pardini (incorporation completed April 28, 2023, ~R$2.4-2.5B deal, CADE unconditional approval; announced June 2022). Hermes Pardini is a wholly-owned subsidiary of publicly-listed Grupo Fleury (FLRY3) since 2023. Sabin is a separate, independent, family-influenced private group from Brasilia that publicly positions itself as a challenger to 'the group resulting from the Fleury-Hermes Pardini merger'. They are only researched together here as two legacy lab chains that both use WhatsApp as a patient channel.
basic_info.category: Diagnostic medicine chains (clinical analysis labs; Hermes Pardini also vaccines, imaging, occupational health). Transactional result-delivery apps — not interpreters.
basic_info.country: Brazil. Sabin: Center-West, North and Federal District core (~80 cities, DF/GO/MT/TO/PA expansion). Hermes Pardini: Minas Gerais core (~60-68 own units) + ~5 units in Sao Paulo state; legacy Grupo Pardini also spanned RS (Weinmann brand).
basic_info.stage: Both mature/established. Sabin: private, growth via M&A (29 acquisitions since 2012), revenue ~R$1.75-1.8B (2023/2024) targeting ~R$2B in 2025, EBITDA margin recovering from 10.7% (2023) to 14-15%. Hermes Pardini: founded 1959, absorbed into Grupo Fleury in 2023; brand kept operating, integration concluded, group accelerated Lab-to-Lab expansion in 2025. Neither is startup-stage; both alive and expanding.
basic_info.pricing_model: No subscription/membership. Classic Brazilian lab mix: health-insurer billing (convenios) + pay-per-exam self-payer pricing + B2B corporate/occupational contracts. Hermes Pardini self-payer reference prices: hemogram ~R$46, creatinine ~R$31, total cholesterol ~R$23, fasting glucose ~R$23, ferritin ~R$68; promotional check-ups R$90-110 (Feminino R$90 / Masculino R$100 / seasonal Outubro Rosa-Novembro Azul R$109.90); Grupo Fleury 'Pra Voce Card' discount card for SP/BH units; up to 25% off imaging partnerships. Sabin positions on popular/self-payer affordability (quotes via WhatsApp/call center; publishes budgets on request, no open price table found). Sabin sells exam+vaccine+check-up bundles in-app. No freemium, no credit system. [uncertain: Sabin exact price points]
basic_info.target_user: Lay patients (B2C) — Sabin skews Center-West/North mass market incl. price-sensitive self-payers; Hermes Pardini skews MG metropolitan + corporate/occupational medicine clients; both also serve ordering physicians (doctor portals) and health plans.
basic_info.scale_metrics: Sabin: ~R$1.75-1.8B revenue (2024/2023 resp.), ~R$2B projected 2025; 360-385 collection units across ~80 cities; R$80M capex and 20 new units planned 2025; 29th acquisition (part of Grupo Doyon, MT) + 28th in Tocantins; Roche-automated core processing ~18,000 tubes/day at ~5h average turnaround; credit rating AA-(bra). Hermes Pardini: ~60-68 own units MG + ~5 SP; pre-merger Grupo Pardini gross revenue ~R$2.25B (2022, +5.4% YoY) [uncertain]; WhatsApp channel: ~25,000 customers served in Jan 2019 alone, ~10% of B2C store customers using WhatsApp (2019 data, pre-merger); combined Fleury group moves ~270M+ exams/year. Durable-threat read: these are distribution/ops fortresses, but patient apps are transactional — neither competes for the interpretation layer.

product.core_features: Sabin app (iOS/Android): online exam results with release alerts, complete exam history, vaccine history/calendar, scheduling (exams, vaccines, check-ups), health-insurer lookup, GPS unit finder, dependents management, online store; biometric login. Hermes Pardini: results via WhatsApp (pioneer since end-2014 — receive results incl. imaging directly in chat, official verified numbers 31 4004-7808 / Labclass 4004-7807), app + MyPardini web portal (user code + password), virtual store with discounted check-ups, scheduling, vaccine appointments, doctor/service WhatsApp lines (11 4020-2573), occupational health arm. Both: paperless PDF results, unit network, vaccines.
product.signature_differentiator: Hermes Pardini: BRAZILIAN PIONEER of exam-result delivery via WhatsApp — WhatsApp Business API deployment since end-2014, iterated into a core channel (verified green-check accounts, end-to-end security codes, segment-specific numbers for B2C vs B2B), with results as the highest-demand WhatsApp action and imaging results deliverable in-chat. This is the oldest, most proven 'WhatsApp as the results channel' playbook in the country. Sabin: regional dominance engine — density in Center-West/North cities big chains ignore, plus family/dependents-first app (health control for 'you, family or patients' with per-dependent vaccine calendar) and a Genesys Cloud omnichannel stack (WhatsApp + chatbot + unified regional contact centers, 2025).
product.lab_data_handling: They ARE the labs: results born in their own LIS/analyzers (Sabin: Roche automation, ~18k tubes/day; Hermes Pardini: large BH plants, 'Enterprise' automation launched pre-merger). Zero upload friction for own exams, zero ingestion of external labs — history is siloed per brand. Patient receives the physician-signed laudo (PDF/report with reference ranges); interpretation is NOT offered — questions are routed to the ordering doctor. No product-driven retest cadence, no wearables/CGM/at-home kits, no annual-checkup engine beyond promotional check-up bundles. Hardware = physical units + home collection options.
product.family_dependents_depth: Sabin: multi-profile dependents in one account ('control your health, your family's or your patients'), per-dependent vaccine calendar/history — the deepest of the two, but still account management: no pediatric reference-range presentation, no caregiver workflow, no hereditary-risk layer. Hermes Pardini: essentially per-patient logins (per-dependente credentials), no family intelligence found. Neither does family health intelligence — same gap as US players; confirmed open lane for Dr. Exame. [uncertain: Hermes Pardini dependent features not publicly documented]
product.doctor_sharing: Both route results to the ordering physician automatically (CRM registered on the request) — Sabin via Portal dos Medicos + app access for CRM-registered doctors; Hermes Pardini via doctor results portals. That is the entire doctor surface: document delivery. No consultation brief, no SOAP, no pre-visit summary, no structured question list, no doctor-facing trend dashboard. Doctor relationship = 'lab serves the ordering physician', patient-side sharing is PDF handoff.
product.action_loop_monetization: Closed internal loop — monetize the NEXT transaction in their own network: seasonal check-up campaigns (Outubro Rosa/Novembro Azul R$109.90), discounted bundles in virtual store, vaccines, imaging partnerships (up to 25% off), Pra Voce Card (Fleury group) for repeat self-payers, Sabin check-ups/vaccine upsells in-app, corporate/occupational contracts (Hermes Pardini strong in medicina do trabalho), and Grupo Fleury Lab-to-Lab wholesale processing riding Hermes Pardini's MG footprint. No supplements, no protocols, no telemedicine-first capture, no marketplace. The loop is 'sell the next exam/vaccine', not 'act on the result'.

technology.ai_approach: Operational/back-office AI only, nothing patient-facing. Hermes Pardini inherits Grupo Fleury's stack: AIDOC AI triage in CT (serious findings flagged ~15 min), Kunumi partnership (COVID hemogram pattern recognition), AI in MRI validation, 3D body-scan AI, internal lab-inventory AI, Microbiology research output. Sabin: Genesys Cloud CX platform with WhatsApp chatbot (2025), automation/RPA core ('automation, AI and process robotization' for tube logistics), Roche Diagnostics lab automation. No LLM, no interpretation engine, no consumer AI claims at either brand.
technology.data_inputs: Own-lab output only: clinical analysis analyzers/LIS, vaccine records, scheduling and service telemetry (Genesys/Sabin, WhatsApp/HP). No wearable, CGM, genomic D2C intake, or questionnaire ingestion found at either brand. [uncertain: internal pilots not publicly verifiable]
technology.data_interoperability: Channel breadth is the notable part: WhatsApp (Hermes Pardini = results delivery + service + scheduling on verified business numbers; Sabin = quotes, service, chatbot via Genesys, results remain app/portal), app + web result portals (laudos.sabin.com.br, MyPardini/hermespardini.com.br, shared Weinmann-platform store), email password recovery, PDF report export, doctor portals, B2B lab-to-lab (Fleury group). Sabin reported COVID results to RNDS (national health data network) during the pandemic. NOT found at either: patient-facing FHIR, Apple Health Records, Android Health Connect, open APIs, external-PDF upload. Same deliberate silo as Fleury/Dasa: data enters via their needles, exits as PDF.
technology.platform: Sabin: iOS/Android apps (br.com.warpzone.zeroum.sabin), web portals, WhatsApp service channel on Genesys, online store. Hermes Pardini: iOS/Android apps (br.com.hermespardini.app_hp), MyPardini web portal + results site (legacy MGW/ms32-era tracking still reachable), WhatsApp Business API channel(s), virtual store. No public developer APIs.

ux.onboarding: Sabin: credentials/protocol handed at collection, app account or portal login (separate logins for online purchases vs results — friction point), biometric unlock after. Hermes Pardini: WhatsApp-first — save the official number, request results in chat; or app/portal with patient code. Time-to-value = time to result release (hours to ~3 business days). First value is 'receive the document', never 'understand it'.
ux.data_visualization: Flat, faithful laudo rendering: PDF/report with lab reference ranges, history list in Sabin app ('complete history with filters and intelligent organization'). No trend graphs, no cross-exam evolution view, no scores, no 'what changed', no lay summaries found at either brand (unlike parent Fleury's app which added evolutionary tables/graphs). Visualization layer is a gap. [uncertain: in-app chart absence inferred from listings/reviews, not hands-on]
ux.engagement_channel: THE channel insight of this research: Hermes Pardini proved in Brazil that WhatsApp IS the retention surface for lab results — pioneer since 2014, results are the highest-demand action, ~25k customers/month served by 2019, imaging results delivered in-chat; patients keep the lab's verified number saved ('salve o contato'). Sabin runs WhatsApp as service/quote/chatbot lane (Genesys) while results live in the app, with documented complaints about automated WhatsApp service for exam inquiries. Both remain transactional: open-on-result then churn; re-engagement via seasonal campaigns (Outubro Rosa/Novembro Azul) and vaccine-calendar pull. No community, streaks, or proactive health nudges. For Dr. Exame: WhatsApp-native delivery + interpretation + memory between exams is exactly the layer these labs refuse to build — their WhatsApp habit validates the channel, their transactional design leaves the relationship unclaimed.

trust_gaps.clinical_validation_trust: Trust = regulated-lab operations: physician-signed laudos, ANVISA/health-surveillance licensing, Sabin Roche-automated plants + ISO-track accreditations, Hermes Pardini 65+ years brand and Microbiology research (11 papers in 2023), parent Fleury CAP ISO 15189. WhatsApp delivery spawned an active fraud ecosystem — Hermes Pardini publishes explicit warnings that it NEVER contacts clients charging for result delivery (scam phishing) and advertises only verified green-check numbers. No patient-facing AI exists, so no AI accuracy claims/methodology to audit at either brand. Billing: promotional prices transparent in virtual stores; insurer tables opaque as usual. Risks: results-channel phishing is a live trust tax on the WhatsApp playbook; Sabin's WhatsApp service automation draws Reclame Aqui complaints.
trust_gaps.regulatory_posture: Provider posture, not SaMD: regulated as diagnostic services; AI sits inside vendor equipment and internal ops, so ANVISA RDC 657/2022 SaMD framing does not touch patient surfaces (there are no patient-facing AI claims). LGPD applies to results handling; WhatsApp delivery relies on verified business accounts + opt-in/consent chains; scam warnings are their main published compliance-adjacent messaging. Interpretation liability is structurally outsourced to the ordering physician — same wall as Fleury/Dasa. For Dr. Exame: another confirmation that Brazil's biggest lab groups treat 'explain the result' as out of scope — the non-diagnosis compliance lane is uncontested.
trust_gaps.gaps_opportunities: GAPS (Dr. Exame openings): (1) No interpretation for laypeople at either brand — result arrives, meaning never does. (2) No longitudinal trends/scores/comparisons (even mid-2020s apps are flat PDF viewers). (3) Siloed histories — Sabin knows only Sabin exams, Hermes Pardini only HP/Fleury exams; a patient mixing labs has no home. Dr. Exame's PDF-ingestion of ANY lab (including Sabin/HP PDFs delivered via WhatsApp) is the unclaimed aggregation layer. (4) Family depth stops at dependent profiles/vaccine calendars — no pediatric ranges, no hereditary risk, no caregiver mode. (5) No doctor brief/SOAP — only automatic laudo routing. (6) No action loop beyond selling the next check-up/vaccine. WHAT WORKS (inspiration, not copy): Hermes Pardini's decade-old WhatsApp results delivery (channel validation + operational maturity + verified-account anti-fraud discipline — copy the channel, not the flatness); Sabin's dependents-first app framing and vaccine calendar as family retention hook; seasonal check-up campaigns as cheap re-activation; Genesys omnichannel unification; Sabin's regional-density M&A engine as a caution that ops scale does not equal relationship ownership.
trust_gaps.relevance: HIGH — but as channel/positioning intel, not competitive threat. Neither group builds interpretation, trends, or family intelligence, and Hermes Pardini's 10-year WhatsApp-results head start (since 2014) is the single strongest Brazilian proof that patients adopt WhatsApp as the results channel — directly de-risking Dr. Exame's WhatsApp strategy. They are upstream suppliers of PDFs and validated habits, not competitors for the meaning layer. Premise correction stands: they are separate groups (Sabin independent; Hermes Pardini under Grupo Fleury since 2023).
